text: About 2.23% of the property was affected by tree-cover loss in 2021. This corresponds to approximately 81.3 hectares of the total 3643.5 hectares. The majority of the affected area, around 68.1 hectares, was planted forest, specifically Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda. The remaining 13.2 hectares were outside mapped forest areas. The tree-cover loss was mapped by Hansen/UMD and corroborated by the JRC 2020 reference data. However, it's important to note that this data does not specify the cause of the tree-cover loss or whether it was legal or illegal.
